Evidence E2 explicitly states that Microsoft Cloud revenue was $63.9 billion for the three months ended September 30, 2026. Since $63.9 billion exceeds $50 billion, the claim is fully supported.

Challenge H1 investigated whether the definition of Microsoft Cloud revenue might differ from expectations. Evidence E10 and E2 consistently define Microsoft Cloud revenue as comprising Azure, Microsoft 365 commercial cloud, and Industry solutions cloud. This definition is clear and consistent across the filings, refuting any concern about definitional ambiguity.

Challenge H2 sought evidence of restatements or corrections to the $63.9 billion figure. No relevant evidence was found indicating any restatement, correction, or revision to the Microsoft Cloud revenue figure for Q1 FY2027.

Challenge H3 investigated whether one-time items or accounting adjustments artificially inflated the revenue. No relevant evidence was found indicating any non-recurring items, special adjustments, or accounting changes that would have artificially inflated Microsoft Cloud revenue above $50 billion.

The initial verdict remains SUPPORTED with no changes.
